settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name Foundry is published on. It must resolve to this server. Foundry binds the license to this host, so pick it before activating the license.
settings.secret_is_set: A value is currently stored — leave blank to keep it.
settings.auth_method_helper: How the Foundry software is fetched and licensed on first start.
settings.foundry_username_helper: foundryvtt.com account used to download the software and fetch a license.
settings.release_url_helper: Timed download URL copied from your foundryvtt.com profile.
settings.license_key_helper: Foundry license key (AAAA-BBBB-...). Optional if account credentials are given — a license is then fetched automatically.
settings.admin_key_helper: Password protecting the Foundry setup/configuration screen.
settings.foundry_version_helper: Specific version to install, e.g. 13.347. Leave empty for the latest stable release.
settings.timezone_helper: TZ database name for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
settings.web_url_desc: Open Foundry VTT in the browser at {url}
settings.license_hint_desc: Foundry Virtual Tabletop is commercial software. You must supply your own foundryvtt.com license; this module does not include one.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
